recipes.name: Quick & Dirty Shakshuka
instructions: Drain & small dice the peppers. Prep or gather any remaining ingredients. Optional - preheat an oven to 400°F/204°C, although this recipe can be made entirely on the stovetop (see step 3).

In an 8” sauté pan over med-high heat, add olive oil then sauté diced peppers for ~60 sec. Add remaining ingredients (except the eggs). Simmer 3-4 mins until reduced and thickened enough to hold a sturdy well (divot for the eggs).

Reduce heat to low. Make 2 wells; crack an egg into each well. Season each with salt. You have two options for cooking the eggs through: Option A: stovetop spirited simmer → once the bottoms of the eggs set, turn heat to medium med-low, cover for ~ 3 mins to steam the top of the eggs. Option B: Slide the pan into a preheated 400°F/204°C oven → bake 5+ mins to desired doneness. You’re looking for fully cooked whites and a jammy yolk.
While the shakshuka is still warm, top w/ feta, a bit of olive oil, & fresh herbs, if desired. Serve with toasted bread.
